title: Greenhouse Effect
definition: A natural process where atmospheric gases trap infrared radiation emitted by the Earth's surface, maintaining the planet's temperature within a range suitable for life. The 'Enhanced Greenhouse Effect' refers to the anthropogenic increase in these gases leading to global warming.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to Environment and Ecology (GS Paper III). It forms the basis for understanding Climate Change, Global Warming, Carbon Sequestration, and international climate negotiations (UNFCCC, Paris Agreement).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Greenhouse Effect.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
